note: The board: ten tracked theatres with a dated log of facts per theatre. The morning run appends one entry per theatre that had a reportable event (newest last) with the cited source rows copied into src, and never edits or deletes old entries. No status labels: the page derives activity from the dates. lat/lon place the marker on the schematic map. short = map label; lp = label position (above, below, left, right).

log.t: The six-day Oleshky (Kherson) ceasefire expired 20:59 GMT on 1 Nov; Russia reportedly refused an extension. The Kremlin says three-way talks in Abu Dhabi come after 4 Nov. The State Department approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC-3 interceptors to Ukraine on 30 Oct. [25, 27, 28]
src: Kherson braces as localised truce ends
Kremlin: Abu Dhabi talks after November 4

log.t: Envoy Steve Witkoff says the US will mediate working-level Ukraine–Russia talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 Nov. Russian bombs killed at least 24 people at a school used for aid handouts in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. [14, 18]
src: U.S. to mediate new Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi next week
Ukraine war latest: Russian bomb strikes kill 24 at humanitarian aid center in Zaporizhzhia Oblast

log.t: The IRGC navy says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz on 31 Oct. Qatari-mediated talks broke up 1–2 Nov with a draft still circulating. [28]

US jets struck radar and missile launchers on Qeshm Island on Monday; a US official called it a defensive operation after Iranian surface-to-air fire. Foreign Minister Araghchi says Hormuz could reopen within two days if Washington ends its blockade, lifts oil sanctions and halts fighting on all fronts. Brent fell 7.6% to $104.77. [16, 17]
src: US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island on eve of midterm elections
Oil slides on Hormuz deal hopes but Trump keeps Iran strikes on the table

log.t: Gaza civil defence said Israeli attacks killed five people on 2 Nov in Khan Younis, Gaza City and central Gaza; health officials count at least 1,580 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire. Israel's military said it killed six Hamas members for ceasefire violations. [102, 103]
src: Israeli attacks kill five in Gaza Strip

log.t: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi drone and a ballistic missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia on 1 Nov; Houthi media reported airstrikes on Ras Isa port and a telecoms site near Saada, with seven wounded at Ras Isa and the Bajil oil facility. Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman raised the Houthi attacks with Hegseth on 3 Nov. [104, 105, 106]
src: Houthis report airstrikes on Red Sea oil port, telecom facility in Yemen
Saudi forces launch airstrike on port of Ras Isa, Yemen

log.t: The Fifth Plenum (26–29 Oct) confirmed the expulsion of 33 senior officials, including 16 military officers and former Central Military Commission members Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli. Since 13 Oct, navy task groups including the carrier Liaoning have moved through the straits north and south of Taiwan. [64]

Taiwan's air force holds its annual Sky Dragon drills 2–6 Nov, and Kinmen held live-fire drills on 3 Nov. Premier Cho Jung-tai said Taiwan is still seeking a formal invitation to the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen on 18–19 Nov. [28, 29, 107]
src: Taiwan air force holds annual Sky Dragon drills
Taiwan seeking formal APEC invitation from China: Premier

log.t: North Korea fired a tactical ballistic missile with a cluster-bomb warhead on 31 Oct and strategic cruise missiles with a cluster warhead on 2 Nov, according to KCNA, while the US–South Korean Freedom Flag exercise runs at Kunsan to 6 Nov. [26, 27]
src: North Korea tests missile with cluster-bomb warhead
North Korea test-fires strategic cruise missiles: KCNA

log.t: Drone strikes on 1 Nov destroyed the Al-Dabbah and Abu Hamad substations, days after hits on Shendi and the 500 MW Um Dabakir plant. A rights group counts 15 substations hit since early October; output is down from about 4,400 MW pre-war to 1,100 MW. Khartoum blames the RSF; the UAE denies arming the RSF. [63]
src: Sudan's power grid nears collapse as drone strikes target electric stations

log.t: Drones hit the New Halfa and Aroma stations in Kassala state and Al-Ghazali near Merowe on 2 Nov, a day after Abu Hamad and Al-Dabbah; Anadolu counts at least 16 stations hit in a week. Sudan filed complaints against Ethiopia at the UN Security Council and the African Union over drone attacks it says were launched from Ethiopian territory. [24, 25]
src: Drone attacks hit 3 power stations in Sudan, trigger widespread outages
Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia with UN over deadly drone spree
